finding: OSM way 265459454 is the outer paid Via 1 of the Vallcarca plaza, not a free bypass. Generalitat project MT-14042-A2, drawing 2.3 (PDF page 370), explicitly draws Via 1 AALT outside the canopy with its toll equipment. July 2026 Street View independently shows the exclusive Via-T sign and barrier at the same outer lane. OSM geometry is retained; no geometry is traced from Google. Apply the published plaza general tariff once, irrespective of Valhalla toll=false. Lane payment-method guidance is separate from the general toll amount.

imagery.limitation: Read-only visual evidence. Capture date not established; no access or toll conclusion from imagery alone.

visualCorroboration.observation: Outer lane has circular T sign, blue approach markings, a separate barrier and detection equipment; not a public free bypass.

resolution.geometry: Existing OSM way 265459454/v9; finite plaza-plane extension to source node 12766694619 plus 8m. No public OSM edit.
